name: Instant Noodles
description: TSA rules for instant noodles and packaged ramen on planes.

carryOn.reason: Instant noodles (dry packaged) are allowed in carry-on baggage without restrictions. Cup noodles without liquid are also fine.

checkedBag.reason: Instant noodles are fully allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring instant noodles on a plane?

travelTips: Dry instant noodles pass through security without any issue
Pre-made liquid cup noodles may trigger the 3-1-1 rule if containing liquid broth

faq.question: Can I bring instant noodles on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, dry instant noodles and packaged ramen are fully allowed in carry-on and checked bags.

faq.question: Can I bring cup noodles on a plane?
faq.answer: Yes, sealed dry cup noodles are allowed in carry-on. Pre-made liquid noodles with broth may be subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule.
